news.title: SLU Partners With Harris-Stowe State University for Accelerated Bachelor's to Master's Pathway in Social Work
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University and Harris-Stowe State University have teamed up for an accelerated bachelor's to master's in social work. The program is designed to create new opportunities for HSSU students to continue their education and prepare for professional careers. news.title: Leaders See Geospatial Science as Key to Future of St. Louis
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University President Edward Feser, Ph.D., hopes the future of geospatial science involves SLU graduates. Feser shared his thoughts on the future of geospatial science and what it means for the city of St. Louis as part of the Leader's Look panel discussion at the 2026 Geo-Resolution conference. news.title: SLU/YouGov Poll: Amendment 3 Falls to a Dead Heat While Missourians Back Protections for the Initiative Petition Process by a 27-Point Margin
news.summary_en: The August 2026 SLU/YouGov Poll surveyed 900 likely Missouri voters about their opinions regarding the 2026 election, ballot initiatives and amendments, data centers, and matters considered by the Missouri state government.
